title: Google wants Gemini 4 Argon to be the only AI model robots need
summary: Google's Gemini 4 Argon is a single AI model built to control robots, generate simulations from photos or sketches, and grade training videos. It scores 87 percent on Google's own ERQA benchmark. But the published example prompts reveal how much careful human guidance the demos still require. The article Google wants Gemini 4 Argon to be the only AI model robots need appeared first on The Decoder .
